hints.title: Frequency Grouping
hints.text: Each operation deletes 2 or 3 elements of identical value, meaning values can be solved independently using frequency counts.

hints.title: Single Occurrence Impossibility
hints.text: If any value has frequency 1, it cannot be deleted using pairs or triplets, so return -1.

hints.title: Greedy Triplet Math
hints.text: For frequency c >= 2, the minimum number of 2s and 3s needed to sum to c is ceil(c / 3), which equals (c + 2) // 3.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Frequency counting followed by integer arithmetic.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive search on deletion combinations branches exponentially.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use frequency map and closed-form greedy formula (c + 2) // 3.
